description: Post-pin source audit of the official Qwen3-ASR streaming implementation for long-session reprocessing behavior. Generation 5 is distinct from the initial official source pin, CrispASR alternate runtime audit, audio.cpp streaming/timestamp reconciliation, and 1.7B sibling audit. Source evidence only; no target-runtime, German-quality, streaming-performance or Trigger-4 acceptance credit.
generation_reason: The earlier Qwen3-ASR source generations did not bind the current upstream implementation's explicit all-audio re-feed behavior or the upstream long-session degradation report. Frankenstein requires long conversations, so this is a new source-level falsifier rather than a repeat of model-family discovery.
